events.title: Bluey's Big Play
events.fit: The live puppet stage show with an original story by the Bluey creator. The Sat and Sun 1:00 PM matinees are the toddler-friendly picks; 6:00 PM shows run into bedtime.
events.onSale: On sale now. Every age needs its own ticket. Buy only from sandiegotheatres.org, Ticketmaster or the box office; some resale sites wrongly list the Civic Theatre.

events.title: Carlsbad Village Street Faire
events.fit: One of the largest one-day street fairs in the country, with 750+ vendors and food. Go early with a stroller, before the crowds peak.

events.title: December Nights
events.whenText: Fri Dec 4 (4–10 PM) · Sat Dec 5 (noon–10 PM)
events.fit: San Diego's biggest holiday festival, free, with lights, music and free museum entry. Saturday afternoon is the toddler-friendly window before the evening crowds.
events.caveat: Draws 350,000+ people over two days. Plan the shuttle or trolley rather than parking.

events.title: Día de los Muertos Celebration
events.fit: A free morning cultural celebration in the arts district.

events.title: Fall Back Festival
events.venue: Gaslamp Museum at the Davis-Horton House
events.fit: A free family celebration of San Diego history at the city's oldest house.

events.title: Great Big Family Play Day
events.fit: A one-day kids' music and activity festival. Laurie Berkner headlines, with The BeatBuds and others on the main stage. Go in the morning and leave before nap.
events.onSale: Timed-entry tickets on Eventbrite. No refunds. The stage schedule is posted at greatbigfamilyplayday.com.

events.title: Halloween in the Village
events.fit: Activities across the Village all afternoon, costumes encouraged. The costume contest's youngest group is ages 4–12, so a 3-year-old enters with the family category.

events.title: Jungle Bells at the San Diego Zoo
events.fit: Holiday light trails and shows from about 5 to 8 PM, included with zoo admission. Arrive mid-afternoon to see animals first.
events.caveat: Dates are from a local guide and marked subject to change; the zoo hasn't published its full 2026 schedule.

events.title: Holidays at LEGOLAND
events.fit: Holiday shows, a 30-foot LEGO tree, snowfall and meet-and-greets, all included with admission. The park is built for ages 2–12.
events.caveat: Event-day list (Nov 21–29, Dec 5–6, 12–13, 19–31, Jan 1–3) comes from a ticket-reseller guide; confirm on legoland.com.

events.title: Liberty Station Tree Lighting
events.fit: The 88-foot Norfolk pine lighting, with live music, firetruck rides and a showing of The Grinch. Free; no tickets needed.

events.title: Lightscape at San Diego Botanic Garden
events.fit: An illuminated after-dark garden trail sold in 15-minute timed slots; ages 2 and under were free last season.
events.caveat: 2026 dates not announced yet. A waitlist on Fever gives presale access.

events.title: Little Italy Tree Lighting & Christmas Village
events.fit: Tree lighting, giant nutcrackers and kinetic holiday displays along the streets.

events.title: MCASD Free Second Sunday & Family Play Day
events.venue: Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego
events.fit: Free museum admission plus a family play day of hands-on art.
events.caveat: Check mcasd.org for which location hosts it.

events.title: North Pole Limited train
events.fit: A 90-minute vintage train ride with hot chocolate, cookies, carols, and Santa and Mrs. Claus visiting every seat. The Sunday 3 PM departure suits a toddler best; Fri/Sat trains leave at 5 and 7 PM.
events.onSale: On sale now. Coach from $15 per child (ages 1–17) and $30 per adult; prices rise closer to Christmas. The best seats sell out.

events.title: Sesame Street Live: Elmo's Got the Moves
events.fit: A movement-based Elmo stage show with sing-alongs. The 2 PM start may overlap nap time.

events.title: Symphony Kids: Meet the Brass – March of the Toys
events.fit: A 30-minute, sensory-friendly San Diego Symphony concert made for ages 0–5. Kids can march and move, and there are crafts before the show.
events.onSale: General admission. Every age needs a ticket, including babies. Check single-ticket availability; a 4-concert package is also sold.

events.title: Symphony Kids: Meet the Percussion – One, Two, Buckle My Shoe
events.fit: A 30-minute drums-and-shakers concert for ages 0–5, sensory-friendly.

events.title: Trick or Treat Symphony
events.fit: A one-hour, not-too-spooky Halloween orchestra concert with crafts an hour before. The series is aimed at ages 6–12, so it may be long for a 3-year-old.
